primary.table: Appendix F, Table F1, printed pp. 47–48

corroboration.table: Table 2, printed pp. 9–10; Table 1B, printed pp. 32–33
corroboration.relationship: Same 49 chamber tests and case counts. The later publication contributes no additional independent outcomes.

source.transcription: Exposure counts by sex, DCS cases, mean TR360, plateau pressure and duration, ambulation marks and separate VGE counts transcribed from Table F1. Table 2 verifies predictors, sex counts and displayed DCS percentages. Table 1B independently prints the same case counts from the same database. Nuc-1 has a denominator of 20 for DCS, 21 exposed. One participant left early for left ventricular gas emboli.
source.discrepancy: Test 10 has no nonambulation checkmark in Table F1. Table 2 explicitly codes AMB=0. Both source entries are retained. The primary analysis excludes test 10.
source.endpoint: Signs or symptoms classified as Type I or II DCS by an independent medical officer, usually during plateau exposure, with a few first reported after the test. Follow-up after return is not uniformly defined in these aggregates.
source.origin: A planned NASA chamber test with a specified plateau duration and the published group mean TR360 and ambulation assignment.

analysis_plan.family: Numbered series are indivisible. Phase I–IV and all V arms form one family. Both Nuc arms form one family. Longer preceding stages lie outside the primary 2–6 hour plateau duration.
analysis_plan.model: Standardize all four covariates using training DCS denominators. Minimize summed grouped binomial negative log likelihood plus one-half the sum of squared standardized coefficients. The intercept is unpenalized.
analysis_plan.comparator: Pooled training cases divided by training DCS denominators in each fold.
analysis_plan.model_selection: Fixed predictors and ridge penalty 1. No tuning, holdout calibration or outcome-dependent selection.
analysis_plan.scoring: Exposure-weighted Bernoulli Brier and log losses computed from grouped case/noncase counts. O:E divides the total observed case count by the sum of denominator times predicted fraction.
analysis_plan.applicability: Only the joint four-feature tuples appearing in the primary training source are supported. The published group mean of computed TR360 and the protocol AMB indicator are required at source precision.

evaluation.design: Leave one entire designated protocol family or component out. Count-weighted standardization, the model and intercept-only comparison are fitted exclusively on each complement.

paired_family_bootstrap.method: Paired nonparametric resampling of held-out families with fixed cross-fitted predictions. Participant and refitting uncertainty are not identified by these intervals.

link_families_with_identical_joint_confi.reason: Hold out connected components of protocol families sharing at least one identical predictor vector.
